title: KTF-001: current-main reliability evidence before daylight execution
description: Fresh replacement for terminal KTF runtime tasks. It proves the two current-main runtime contracts with the existing deterministic test fixtures, then creates a bounded operator brief. It does not edit source, apply a manifest, claim another task, publish, push, or merge. The two free-exec packets are deliberately documentation outcomes backed by executable gates: they give the daylight operator current evidence without asking a free worker to design or repair code.

packets.title: Record the controlled current-main continuation and exit-75 proof
packets.objective: Execution class: free-exec. One outcome only: create docs/research/ktf-004-current-main-runtime-proof.md after the three exact current-main tests below exit 0. Before running them, require `git merge-base --is-ancestor f9dfb6a HEAD` to exit 0 and require that the report file does not already exist. Run exactly: `python3.12 -m pytest tests/test_builder_run.py -q --tb=short -k 'test_exhausted_packet_does_not_stop_unrelated_packet or test_worker_provider_exhaustion_pauses_without_consuming_attempt_budget or test_reviewer_provider_exhaustion_is_resumable'`. Then write a concise report containing these exact lines: `controlled runtime proof: passed`, `unrelated continuation: passed`, `provider exhaustion exit 75: passed`, and `inspected HEAD: <the output of git rev-parse HEAD>`. Do not edit source, tests, manifests, or Builder state. STOPPING RULE: if the ancestry check fails, any named test fails, or the report already exists, make no change and fail the attempt. Do not substitute a different test, test selector, commit, or report path.
acceptance_criteria: The report exists only after all three named tests pass on a HEAD descended from f9dfb6a.
The report records the inspected immutable HEAD and each of the three required pass markers.
No source, test, manifest, Builder, Git remote, or GitHub state is changed.

packets.title: Write the bounded daylight operator brief
packets.objective: Execution class: free-exec. One outcome only: create docs/research/ktf-004-daylight-operator-brief.md. Before writing, require the KTF-RP-01 report to be non-empty and to contain all three pass markers named in its validation commands. The new file must state exactly these four headings: `# KTF-004 daylight operator brief`, `## Preconditions`, `## Required evidence`, and `## Stop conditions`. Under Preconditions, state that independent review of KTF-RP-01 and KTF-RP-02 plus canonical-checkout application are required before any daylight run. Under Required evidence, name task, attempt, lease, validation, review, Git, GitHub, provider-exhaustion, and continuation evidence. Under Stop conditions, state `Do not push, publish, merge, retry a terminal task, or select a life project automatically.` and `If a supported source is unavailable or disagrees, stop and report unknown.` Do not run Builder, apply a manifest, edit another file, or create a PR. STOPPING RULE: if the input report is missing a required marker or the output brief already exists, make no change and fail the attempt; do not write a partial brief.
acceptance_criteria: The brief is created only from a complete KTF-RP-01 proof report.
The brief names every required evidence surface and every stop condition.
The brief does not claim a daylight run happened or grant publication authority.
validation_commands: grep -q 'Do not push, publish, merge, retry a terminal task, or select a life project automatically.' docs/research/ktf-004-daylight-operator-brief.md
